question: Who was the other Herati shaykh Ibn Turka says he admonished?
proposition: The shaykh was almost certainly Qāsim-i Anvār, who was later expelled from Herat.
reasoning: MK writes ‘almost certainly’ without giving grounds on the page.
MK elsewhere notes Qāsim-i Anvār was Ibn Turka's Cairo companion; that note is on p.32.
